public_layers.land_candidate_surface: GSI DEM-supported land surface, acquired with the production build_gsi_dem_for_bounds path
public_layers.ndvi_source: ESA WorldCover annual Sentinel-2 NDVI composite 2021 v200

occurrences.taxon_scope: predeclared speciesKey within its predeclared island cell

applicability_gate.training_land_fraction: fraction of thinned training occurrences supported by finite GSI DEM land surface
applicability_gate.pair_conditional_eligibility: all five predeclared training folds must be data-adequate and terrestrial-policy applicable

selection.method: q=0.10 NDVI-state nearest-prototype eligibility then exact sparse greedy maximum newly covered land-grid cells
selection.control: q=1.00 exact sparse greedy maximum newly covered land-grid cells

primary_estimand.fold_aggregation: mean recall across the five valid folds
primary_estimand.comparison: frozen q10 K5 method minus q1 K5 strong geographic coverage
primary_estimand.promotion_rule: all minimum-eligible/eligibility/effect conditions must pass; otherwise confirmation fails and no retuning is allowed

failure_handling.data_or_domain_inapplicable_pairs: excluded only from conditional terrestrial-policy effect; remain in declared-cohort applicability denominator
failure_handling.method_failure_on_an_eligible_fold: assign zero recall to the failed method for that fold and retain the comparator result if available
failure_handling.unresolved_infrastructure_failure: reported separately and prevents a promotion claim until rerun/recovery resolves it without changing scientific settings

practicality_and_robustness.robustness_interpretation: diagnostic only; cannot rescue a failed primary confirmation gate

claim_boundary.if_primary_passes: supports transfer of the frozen low-budget K5 ecological-eligibility-plus-set-coverage survey policy to new vascular-plant taxa and new Japanese island domains that pass the frozen training-only terrestrial applicability gate
claim_boundary.if_primary_fails: do not retune on this cohort; retain the result as a limit on transferability and reopen development only on a new development cohort
